## **Coaching Note for the Club Player (1500 rating)**

You had a back-rank mating pattern staring at you! When your opponent's king has limited escape squares—trapped on the edge with blocked by its own pawns—look for a knight or queen that can deliver check and force the king into a fatal corner. Here, Ne2+ forces Kh1, then Qd1+ drives it to h2, where Qg1 is checkmate. **Key lesson:** Knights and queens work together brilliantly on cramped boards. Always scan for forcing checks when the enemy king looks boxed in.
